title: Australia & New Zealand: 46 Days Across Australia's Iconic Landmarks & New Zealand's Wonders
description: An epic 46-day vegetarian-friendly adventure spanning NSW, Queensland, Northern Territory, South Australia, Victoria, and Tasmania — plus a week in New Zealand. From the Sydney Opera House to Uluru, the Great Barrier Reef to MONA in Hobart, with meaningful family and friends visits woven throughout.

days.neighborhoods: Sydney CBD · Circular Quay · The Rocks
days.title: Arrival in Sydney — Harbour Views & Family Reunion
days.description: Sunday, May 3 — Arrive in Sydney, soak in the iconic harbour, reconnect with friends and family.

activities.name: ✈️ Arrive at Sydney Airport
activities.description: Grab an Opal card, Airport Link to Circular Quay (~20 min). Drop bags. Walk from Circular Quay to Opera House, through Royal Botanic Gardens to Mrs Macquarie's Chair for the iconic combined view.

activities.name: 🏘️ The Rocks Historic District
activities.description: Cobblestone lanes, heritage pubs, weekend markets. Sydney's oldest neighborhood.

days.title: Blue Mountains — Three Sisters & Scenic World
days.description: Monday, May 4 — Day trip to the stunning Blue Mountains. Dramatic cliffs, ancient rainforest, iconic formations.

activities.name: 🚂 Train to Katoomba
activities.description: Blue Mountains Line from Central (~2 hrs). Sit left for views. Most iconic viewpoint. Giant Stairway (998 steps) to valley-floor rainforest.

activities.name: 🚡 Scenic World
activities.description: Steepest railway in the world into ancient rainforest. Glass-floor Skyway. Jurassic fern boardwalk.

days.title: Bondi to Coogee Walk & Harbour Bridge Climb
days.description: Tuesday, May 5 — Sydney's two greatest hits: the coastal walk and Bridge climb.

activities.name: 🏖️ Bondi to Coogee Walk
activities.description: 6km of sandstone cliffs, coves, ocean pools. Bondi→Tamarama→Bronte→Clovelly→Coogee.

activities.name: 🌉 BridgeClimb
activities.description: 360° views from 134m. Twilight climb for sunset views.

days.title: Manly Ferry & Sydney Family Day
days.description: Wednesday, May 6 — Morning ferry to Manly Beach, afternoon free for friends and family.

activities.name: ⛴️ Ferry to Manly
activities.description: 30-min ferry past Opera House, under Bridge. Best $7 experience in Sydney. Surf-town vibe. Walk The Corso to the ocean; snorkel at Shelly Beach marine reserve.

activities.name: 🏡 Free Afternoon with Friends & Family
activities.description: Let your hosts show you their Sydney — BBQ, secret beach, favourite pub.

days.title: Fly Sydney → Auckland — Great Grandfather's Legacy
days.description: Thursday, May 7 — Fly to Auckland for the most personal part of the trip — your great grandfather's grave.

activities.name: ✈️ Sydney → Auckland (3 hrs)
activities.description: Cross the Tasman. NZ is 2 hrs ahead of AEST. Grab a NZ SIM + rental car at airport.

activities.name: 🪦 Visit Great Grandfather's Grave
activities.description: Research the cemetery in advance — findagrave.com or Auckland Council cemetery search. Bring flowers. Clear your head with a walk along Viaduct Harbour and Wynyard Quarter.

days.title: Auckland — Mt Eden & Waiheke Island
days.description: Friday, May 8 — Volcanic cone summit, then ferry to Waiheke Island for world-class wine and beaches.

activities.name: 🌋 Mt Eden (Maungawhau)
activities.description: Auckland's highest natural point (196m). Extinct crater with 360° views. Sacred Māori site — stay on paths.

activities.name: ⛴️ Waiheke Island Day Trip
activities.description: 40-min ferry to Auckland's island paradise. Beaches, world-class wineries, olive groves. Rent bikes or take the local bus.

days.title: Auckland → Hobbiton → Rotorua
days.description: Saturday, May 9 — Drive south via Hobbiton and the geothermal wonderland of Rotorua.

activities.name: 🧙 Hobbiton Movie Set
activities.description: The real Shire from Lord of the Rings near Matamata. Full-detail sets, ending at the Green Dragon Inn.

activities.name: ♨️ Te Puia Geothermal Valley
activities.description: Boiling mud pools, Pohutu Geyser (30m high), Māori cultural performance, kiwi conservation centre. Thermal mineral pools overlooking Lake Rotorua. 36–42°C. Perfect after a long drive.

days.title: Wai-O-Tapu → Taupo → Wellington
days.description: Sunday, May 10 — Colorful geothermal pools, NZ's largest lake, then drive to Wellington.

activities.name: 🟡 Wai-O-Tapu Thermal Wonderland
activities.description: The Champagne Pool (vivid orange/green minerals), Artist's Palette, Devil's Bath, mud pools.

activities.name: 🚗 Taupo → Wellington (~4 hrs)
activities.description: Desert Road with views of Ruapehu, Tongariro, Ngauruhoe (Mt Doom). Along Kapiti Coast into Wellington.

days.title: Wellington — Te Papa, Cuba Street & Cable Car
days.description: Monday, May 11 — Explore NZ's compact, creative capital before the conference begins.

activities.name: 🏛️ Te Papa Tongarewa
activities.description: World-class museum — FREE. Māori history, colossal squid exhibit, earthquake simulation, NZ art.

activities.name: 🚋 Wellington Cable Car
activities.description: Red cable car to Kelburn lookout. Walk back down through the Botanic Gardens. Bohemian heart of Wellington. Street art, vintage shops, record stores, best cafes and bars.

days.title: Wellington Conference Day 1
days.description: Tuesday, May 12 — Conference sessions and networking. Evening free to explore Wellington's legendary bar scene.

activities.name: 🎤 Conference Day 1 (May 13)
activities.description: Full day of sessions and networking at the Wellington conference venue.

activities.name: 🍸 Wellington's Craft Beer & Bar Scene
activities.description: NZ's best bar scene. Goldings Free Dive for craft beer on tap, Hawthorn Lounge for speakeasy cocktails.

days.title: Wellington Conference Day 2 & Farewell Dinner
days.description: Wednesday, May 13 — Final conference day. Celebrate with a harbour-view dinner.

activities.name: 🎤 Conference Day 2 (May 14)
activities.description: Final sessions. Make the most of connections and exchange contacts.

activities.name: 🌅 Oriental Bay Walk
activities.description: Wellington's prettiest sandy beach. City skyline backdrop. Perfect sunset stroll.

days.neighborhoods: New Plymouth · Mt Taranaki · Coastal Walkway
days.title: Fly to New Plymouth — Friends & Family
days.description: Thursday, May 14 — Short flight to New Plymouth. Friends and family await with Mt Taranaki as a stunning backdrop.

activities.name: ✈️ Wellington → New Plymouth (45 min)
activities.description: Spectacular Mt Taranaki views on approach to the city.

activities.name: 🏔️ Mt Taranaki Viewpoints
activities.description: Perfectly conical volcano. Drive to North Egmont Visitor Centre for walks and dramatic views. 13km scenic walkway along the dramatic coastline. The Wind Wand sculpture and world-class Len Lye contemporary art centre.

days.title: New Plymouth → Fly Back to Sydney
days.description: Friday, May 15 — Say goodbye to NZ. Fly back to Sydney to continue the Australia adventure.

activities.name: ☕ Last Morning in NZ
activities.description: Breakfast with friends. Sunrise walk with Mt Taranaki glowing in morning light. Connect through Auckland. ~5 hours total travel time.

days.title: Sydney → Drive North → Yamba
days.description: Saturday, May 16 — Begin the coastal drive north to Yamba where friends and family await.

activities.name: 🚗 Pick Up Car & Drive North
activities.description: Pacific Highway (M1/A1) heading north. ~660km to Yamba — break with scenic stops. Free-roaming koala hospital. Feeding times at 8am and 3pm. Touching 30-min stop.

activities.name: 🏖️ Arrive in Yamba
activities.description: Voted Australia's #1 town. Gorgeous coastal town at Clarence River mouth. Friends and family here.

days.title: Yamba — Beaches, Blue Pool & Friends
days.description: Sunday, May 17 — Full day in Yamba with friends and family. Pristine beaches and the famous Angourie Blue Pool.

activities.name: 🏊 Angourie Blue Pool
activities.description: Natural rock pool with crystal-clear blue water surrounded by pandanus palms. One of Australia's best-kept secrets. Beautiful beaches. Turners is sheltered; Pippi stretches for miles.

activities.name: 🏡 Quality Time with Friends & Family
activities.description: Explore what your hosts love about Yamba. River fishing, beach walks, pub lunches.

days.neighborhoods: Lennox Head · Byron Bay · Brunswick Heads
days.title: Yamba → Byron Bay — Australia's Beach Mecca
days.description: Monday, May 18 — Drive south to Byron Bay. Friends and family here too. Beaches, markets, and one of Australia's best restaurants.

activities.name: 🚗 Yamba → Byron Bay (~2 hrs)
activities.description: Scenic coastal drive south via Lennox Head — stop at the lookout for incredible surf views. Walk to Cape Byron — Australia's most easterly point. Lighthouse and whale-watching (May–November is peak migration).

activities.name: 🏡 Friends & Family Time
activities.description: Beach picnics, sunset sessions, live music. Byron is perfect for relaxed gatherings.

days.title: Fly Byron Region → Cairns — Tropical Gateway
days.description: Tuesday, May 19 — Fly to tropical North Queensland — gateway to the Great Barrier Reef and Daintree Rainforest.

activities.name: ✈️ Ballina/Gold Coast → Cairns (~2.5 hrs)
activities.description: Arrive in the tropics. Cairns in May: 20–28°C, dry season — perfect conditions.

activities.name: 🏖️ Cairns Esplanade & Lagoon
activities.description: Free saltwater swimming lagoon. Tropical parkland, BBQs, mountain backdrop. Cairns has no city beach — this is where everyone swims. Buzzing night market with Asian street food, massages, souvenirs. Vegetarian paradise.

days.title: Great Barrier Reef — Snorkeling Day Trip
days.description: Wednesday, May 20 — The experience of a lifetime — snorkel the world's largest coral ecosystem.

activities.name: 🐠 Great Barrier Reef Snorkeling
activities.description: Full-day boat trip to the outer reef. Coral gardens, tropical fish, sea turtles, Māori wrasse. Multiple snorkel sites.

days.neighborhoods: Cape Tribulation · Daintree River · Mossman Gorge
days.title: Daintree Rainforest — World's Oldest Tropical Forest
days.description: Thursday, May 21 — Explore the 180-million-year-old Daintree Rainforest where the rainforest meets the reef.

activities.name: 🐊 Daintree River Cruise
activities.description: Spot crocodiles, kingfishers, and tree snakes. Early morning is best for wildlife. Where the rainforest meets the Great Barrier Reef — the only place on earth this happens. Boardwalk through ancient lowland rainforest.

activities.name: 🏞️ Mossman Gorge
activities.description: Sacred Aboriginal site. Crystal-clear swimming holes, massive granite boulders, lush rainforest.

days.title: Fly Cairns → Darwin — Frontier City (Friends & Family)
days.description: Friday, May 22 — Fly to Australia's tropical northern capital. Dry season perfection. Friends and family here.

activities.name: ✈️ Cairns → Darwin (~2.5 hrs)
activities.description: Cross the top of Australia. Darwin is completely different — frontier town, Asian-influenced culture.

activities.name: 🏖️ Darwin Waterfront Precinct
activities.description: Modern waterfront with lagoon, restaurants, and bars. Stroll along the waterfront and watch the cruise ships. Darwin's famous Thursday/Sunday sunset market (May–Oct). Hundreds of food stalls — incredible Southeast Asian street food.

days.title: Kakadu National Park — Ancient Art & Waterfalls
days.description: Saturday, May 23 — One of the world's great wilderness parks. Ancient Aboriginal rock art and spectacular waterfalls.

activities.name: 🪨 Ubirr Rock Art Site
activities.description: Some of the most significant Aboriginal rock art on Earth — 20,000+ years old. Walk the circuit through galleries of X-ray fish, humans, and Dreamtime figures. Climb to the lookout above Ubirr for sweeping views across the floodplains. Incredible at dawn.

activities.name: 🐊 Yellow Water Wetlands Cruise
activities.description: Billabong cruise teeming with saltwater crocodiles, jabiru storks, sea eagles, and other wildlife. Sunrise and afternoon cruises available. Short boardwalk through freshwater wetlands. Thousands of magpie geese and other waterbirds in the dry season.

days.neighborhoods: Darwin CBD · Litchfield NP · Berry Springs
days.title: Darwin City & Litchfield National Park
days.description: Sunday, May 24 — Explore Darwin's history and cool off in Litchfield's stunning waterfall swimming holes.

activities.name: 🏛️ Museum & Art Gallery of the NT
activities.description: World-class collection of Aboriginal art and the dramatic Cyclone Tracy exhibition. Free entry. 145-year-old gardens with 450+ tropical plant species. Beautiful walking paths and banyan trees.

activities.name: 🏊 Wangi Falls & Florence Falls (Litchfield NP)
activities.description: Spectacular waterfalls with safe swimming holes. Wangi is a large plunge pool surrounded by monsoon forest; Florence requires a steep walk but fewer crowds.

days.title: Fly Darwin → Adelaide — South Australia
days.description: Monday, May 25 — Fly south to Adelaide. From the Top End to one of Australia's most liveable cities.

activities.name: 🌅 Bicentennial Park & Esplanade
activities.description: Morning walk along Darwin's waterfront esplanade. WWII oil storage tunnels nearby. Cross the continent. Adelaide is 1.5 hrs behind Darwin (ACST).

activities.name: 🌳 Adelaide Oval & River Torrens Walk
activities.description: Walk along the river past the iconic Adelaide Oval. Cross the Peace Park footbridge and explore North Adelaide. 30 min tram from CBD. Adelaide's beach suburb with a lovely sunset strip.

days.title: Adelaide — Central Market, Barossa Valley & Friends
days.description: Tuesday, May 26 — Explore Adelaide's food scene and day-trip to the world-famous Barossa Valley wine region.

activities.name: 🍷 Barossa Valley Day Trip
activities.description: One of the world's great wine regions. Drive 1 hour north to Barossa for cellar door tastings, local produce, and rolling vineyard scenery.

activities.name: 🇩🇪 Hahndorf — Australia's Oldest German Village
activities.description: Charming 1839 German settlement in the Adelaide Hills. Stroll the main street of historic timber buildings, bakeries, and craft shops.

days.title: Adelaide Family Day & Fly to Melbourne
days.description: Wednesday, May 27 — Final morning with Adelaide friends and family, then fly to Melbourne.

activities.name: 🏡 Last Morning with Friends & Family
activities.description: Slow morning — walk to a local cafe, visit Haigh's Chocolates (Australian institution since 1915), or explore the Adelaide Botanic Garden.

activities.name: ✈️ Adelaide → Melbourne (~1.5 hrs)
activities.description: Arrive in Melbourne by mid-afternoon. Drop bags and explore the iconic CBD laneways — Degraves Street, Centre Place, Hosier Lane street art.

days.title: Melbourne — Queen Victoria Market, Laneways & Culture
days.description: Thursday, May 28 — Melbourne's legendary food culture, markets, galleries, and street art scene.

activities.name: 🥕 Queen Victoria Market
activities.description: Australia's largest open-air market since 1878. The deli hall is a vegetarian dream — cheese, olives, dips, pastries from around the world. Melbourne is the coffee capital of the Southern Hemisphere. Sensory Lab, Seven Seeds, or Patricia Coffee Brewers — all within walking distance.

activities.name: 🏛️ National Gallery of Victoria (NGV)
activities.description: Australia's most-visited art museum. Permanent collection includes Rembrandt, Monet, Warhol, and the world's largest collection of Australian Aboriginal art. Tram to St Kilda for the iconic beach, Luna Park, and the famous cake shops on Acland Street.

days.title: Great Ocean Road — Shipwreck Coast & 12 Apostles
days.description: Friday, May 29 — One of the world's great coastal drives. Dramatic sea stacks, surfing towns, and ancient shipwrecks.

activities.name: 🚗 Drive the Great Ocean Road (Day 1)
activities.description: Pick up rental car (or join a day tour). Start at the arch memorial near Torquay and drive southwest. The famous surf break where the world championships are held. Not a swimming beach — watch the waves from the cliff top.

activities.name: 🪨 The Twelve Apostles
activities.description: The most iconic view on the Great Ocean Road — limestone sea stacks rising from the Southern Ocean. Particularly magical at sunset. Helicopter tours over the 12 Apostles give a completely different perspective — worth it for special occasions.

days.title: Great Ocean Road Day 2 — Rainforest & Return
days.description: Saturday, May 30 — Explore the ancient rainforest of Otway National Park, then return to Melbourne.

activities.name: 🌿 Otway National Park — Triplet Falls & Treetop Walk
activities.description: Ancient temperate rainforest with massive tree ferns, myrtle beech, and Otway podocarps. Triplet Falls is stunning. The Otway Fly Treetop Walk (25m above the forest floor) is unforgettable. The Grey River Road behind Kennett River has the highest density of wild koalas in Victoria. Just look up in the eucalyptus trees.

activities.name: 🚗 Drive Back to Melbourne (~2.5 hrs from Lorne)
activities.description: Return via Geelong. Stop at Torquay surf shops if you want surf gear or gifts.

days.title: Fly Melbourne → Hobart, Tasmania
days.description: Sunday, May 31 — Fly to the island of Tasmania. Moody, artistic, wild. Friends and family here.

activities.name: ✈️ Melbourne → Hobart (~1 hr)
activities.description: Short hop across the Bass Strait to Tasmania, Australia's southernmost state.

activities.name: 🏛️ MONA (Museum of Old and New Art)
activities.description: One of the world's most provocative and extraordinary private art museums. Built into sandstone cliffs below the surface. No children under 18. Walk the historic sandstone waterfront. Australia's oldest wharf precinct.

days.title: Cradle Mountain — Tasmania's Wilderness Icon
days.description: Monday, June 1 — One of Australia's most dramatic landscapes. Ancient dolerite peaks reflected in glacial lakes.

activities.name: 🏔️ Cradle Mountain NP (day trip from Hobart or stay nearby)
activities.description: Drive 3 hours north to Cradle Mountain. The Dove Lake Circuit (6km, 2-3 hrs) circles a glacial lake with extraordinary views of the jagged peaks. Wombats and wallabies are common.

days.neighborhoods: Freycinet NP · Wineglass Bay · Coles Bay
days.title: Freycinet — Wineglass Bay & Pink Granite
days.description: Tuesday, June 2 — Tasmania's most iconic image — Wineglass Bay viewed from the saddle above pink granite peaks.

activities.name: 🏖️ Wineglass Bay Lookout
activities.description: Hike up the saddle (45 min each way, steep but worth every step) for the famous view of the perfect crescent bay. One of the top 10 beaches in the world. Continue down to the bay itself for a swim in crystal-clear water. Add 2 hours return.

days.neighborhoods: Hobart · Darwin or direct to Uluru
days.title: Tasmania — Family Day & Fly to Uluru
days.description: Wednesday, June 3 — Final morning in Tasmania with friends and family, then fly to the Red Centre.

activities.name: 🏡 Final Tasmania Morning
activities.description: Slow breakfast with Tasmanian friends and family. Maybe a walk along the Hobart Rivulet or up Mt Wellington. Australia's oldest brewery (1832). Tours end with tastings — good veggie food in the restaurant.

activities.name: ✈️ Hobart → Adelaide or Melbourne → Uluru (Ayers Rock Airport)
activities.description: Multi-leg flight to the Red Centre. Ayers Rock Airport serves Uluru directly from Sydney and Melbourne.

days.title: Uluru — Sunrise, Cultural Walk & Kata Tjuta
days.description: Thursday, June 4 — The most sacred site in Australia. Watch the sunrise paint Uluru in impossible colours.

activities.name: 🌅 Uluru Sunrise (please don't sleep in)
activities.description: Drive to the sunset viewing area before dawn (~5:30am in May). Watch Uluru transform from dark purple to ochre to blazing orange as the sun rises. Truly one of the world's great experiences. 7km walk around the base of Uluru (2.5-3 hours). Pass Mutitjulu Waterhole, ancient rock art, and geological formations. Rangers lead free walks.

activities.name: 🌀 Kata Tjuta — Valley of the Winds Walk
activities.description: 36 domed rock formations, collectively more ancient than Uluru. The Valley of the Winds walk (7.4km, 3-4 hrs) passes through narrow gorges between massive red rocks. Watch the last light of day illuminate the domes of Kata Tjuta — equally spectacular to Uluru at sunset.

days.neighborhoods: Uluru · Cultural Centre · Field of Light
days.title: Uluru — Anangu Culture & Desert Astronomy
days.description: Friday, June 5 — Go deeper into Anangu culture and experience the Red Centre night sky — one of Earth's best stargazing spots.

activities.name: 🏛️ Uluru-Kata Tjuta Cultural Centre
activities.description: The Anangu tell their story through art and exhibits. Browse the Maruku Arts gallery for genuine dot paintings and wooden carvings made by local artists. Ride a camel around the edge of Uluru at sunrise or sunset — surprisingly moving experience in the Red Centre silence.

activities.name: ✨ Field of Light (Bruce Munro installation)
activities.description: 50,000 solar-powered spheres bloom across the desert sand after dark. One of the world's largest art installations. Walking through it under the stars with Uluru as a backdrop is magical.

days.title: Fly Uluru → Sydney — Final Stretch Begins
days.description: Saturday, June 6 — Return to Sydney to begin the final week of this extraordinary journey.

activities.name: 🌅 Final Uluru Sunrise (optional)
activities.description: If you have energy, catch one more sunrise. You'll never tire of it. Multiple daily flights. Arrive early afternoon.

days.title: Sydney — Australian Wildlife Encounters
days.description: Sunday, June 7 — Spend a day getting close to Australian wildlife before the trip ends.

activities.name: 🦘 Featherdale Wildlife Park
activities.description: Australia's best wildlife park for getting close to animals. Hand-feed kangaroos, hold a koala (permitted in NSW), see Tasmanian devils, wombats, echidnas, and quolls.

activities.name: 🦒 Taronga Zoo (afternoon option)
activities.description: World-class zoo with spectacular harbour views. Best Australian animal exhibits including night zoo, koala sanctuary, and giraffe feeding. End the day at Manly for a final swim and sunset drinks.

days.title: Sydney — Hunter Valley Wine Day Trip
days.description: Monday, June 8 — Day trip to one of Australia's oldest wine regions, just 2 hours from Sydney.

activities.name: 🍷 Hunter Valley Day Trip
activities.description: Australia's oldest wine region (since 1820s). Take a shuttle tour from Sydney or self-drive. 28 hectares of themed gardens on the estate of the Hunter Resort. Beautiful for photos.

days.title: Sydney — Final Cultural Day & Farewell Dinner
days.description: Tuesday, June 9 — A final day savoring Sydney's creative neighborhoods and a special farewell dinner.

activities.name: 🎨 Newtown — Sydney's Creative Heart
activities.description: King Street, Newtown is a 2km stretch of vintage stores, vegan cafes, bookshops, and street art. Sydney's most characterful neighborhood. Campos Coffee (originated here), the Wedge, Sweatshop Espresso — some of Sydney's best third-wave coffee.

activities.name: 🌳 Hyde Park & Australian Museum
activities.description: Free stroll through Hyde Park with the ANZAC War Memorial. Australian Museum next door has excellent Aboriginal cultural collections. One of Australia's premier art galleries. The Yiribana Aboriginal art gallery is outstanding. Free permanent collection.

days.title: Final Morning in Sydney & Departure
days.description: Wednesday, June 10 — Savour the last Sydney morning. One final harbour glimpse before heading home.

activities.name: 🌅 One Last Harbour Walk
activities.description: Morning walk along the foreshore — Circular Quay to the Opera House. The harbour is different every morning. Treat yourself to a proper flat white at one of Sydney's great specialty cafes. You'll miss it.

activities.name: ✈️ Depart Sydney
activities.description: Head to the airport. Airport Link from Central (~20 min). Check-in 3 hours early for international, 1.5 hours for domestic.

days.title: Rest Day — Sydney Flex Day
days.description: Thursday, June 11 — A buffer day in Sydney — catch anything you missed, revisit favourites, or simply relax.

activities.name: 🔄 Flex Day — Your Choice
activities.description: Use this day however serves you best. Extra time at a museum? Another coastal walk? Shopping for gifts? Or simply read in the Botanic Gardens and soak it all in.

days.neighborhoods: Royal National Park · Stanwell Park · Wattamolla
days.title: NSW South Coast Day Trip — Royal National Park
days.description: Friday, June 12 — Australia's oldest national park, just 1 hour south of Sydney. Dramatic clifftops and hidden lagoons.

activities.name: 🏔️ Royal National Park — Coast Track Highlights
activities.description: The RNP coast track has some of the most dramatic coastal scenery in NSW. Drive to Bundeena and walk south to Marley Beach, or walk from Otford up to Stanwell Park clifftops.

activities.name: 🏊 Wattamolla Lagoon
activities.description: A stunning natural lagoon inside the Royal National Park — rope swing into a fresh lagoon, then walk 5 min to a gorgeous beach.

days.title: Canberra Day Trip — Australian Capital
days.description: Saturday, June 13 — Drive 3 hours to Australia's capital — often overlooked but full of world-class institutions.

activities.name: 🚗 Sydney → Canberra (3 hrs)
activities.description: Drive south via Federal Highway. Arrive mid-morning. One of the world's great war memorials. Moving and comprehensive. Allow 2 hours.

activities.name: 🎨 National Gallery of Australia
activities.description: The definitive collection of Australian art including the world's largest Jackson Pollock and an extraordinary Indigenous art collection. Australian history from first peoples to today. Excellent rotating exhibitions.

days.title: Sydney — Paddington Markets & Centennial Park
days.description: Sunday, June 14 — A relaxed local day in one of Sydney's most beautiful neighborhoods.

activities.name: 🛍️ Paddington Markets (Saturday)
activities.description: Sydney's best boutique market — local designers, artists, vintage fashion, and artisan food. Held in the grounds of a heritage church since 1973. Stroll the leafy streets lined with Victorian terrace houses. Sydney's most charming residential area.

activities.name: 🌳 Centennial Park
activities.description: 220 hectares of parkland with ponds, horse riding, cycling, and a Victorian rose garden. Hire bikes from the gates.

days.title: Northern Beaches Day — Palm Beach & Barrenjoey
days.description: Monday, June 15 — Sydney's Northern Beaches stretch for 30km north of Manly. Palm Beach is the jewel at the end.

activities.name: 🚗 Drive to Palm Beach (~1.5 hrs from CBD)
activities.description: Or take the L90 bus from the city. Palm Beach is used as filming location for Home and Away and has an other-worldly beauty. 20-minute steep walk to the lighthouse at the tip of the peninsula. Views north to the Central Coast and south to Sydney on a clear day.

days.title: Departure Day — Farewell Australia
days.description: Wednesday, June 17 — The last morning. 46 days. Every state and territory. Two countries. Unforgettable.

activities.name: ☀️ Final Sydney Morning
activities.description: If time allows, one last flat white and a quiet moment to reflect. 46 days across the bottom of the world — you've done something remarkable. Airport Link from Central Station (~20 min). International check-in 3 hours before departure.
